<div class="project-card" id="heliostato">
<h3>Solar Heliostat Control and Instrumentation</h3>
<p>Doctoral research at IER-UNAM since 2026, focused on closed-loop heliostat control through sensor-based feedback. The work places primary emphasis on computer vision while considering complementary sensing methods for positioning. The experimental research encompasses the heliostat, solar furnace, instrumentation and control system.</p>
<p class="badges">
  <span class="badge">Doctoral Research</span>
  <span class="badge">Control</span>
  <span class="badge">Instrumentation</span>
</p>
<img class="project-media" src="../images/heliostato.jpg" alt="Heliostat and experimental solar furnace infrastructure at IER-UNAM">
</div>
</div>

<div class="col-md-6">
<div class="project-card">
<h3>Interactive Solar Furnace Simulator</h3>
<p>An educational and experimental simulator in development for exploring a solar furnace with a heliostat and faceted concentrator. It integrates solar tracking, reflection geometry, 3D visualization and reproducible experiments with orientation errors and correction strategies. It includes a web version that runs Python directly in the browser and a desktop version written in Python.</p>
<p class="badges">
  <span class="badge">Python</span>
  <span class="badge">Shinylive</span>
  <span class="badge">Pyodide</span>
  <span class="badge">3D Visualization</span>
  <span class="badge">In Development</span>
</p>
<img class="project-media" src="../images/Simulador_horno.png" alt="Interface of the interactive solar furnace simulator">
<p class="links">
  <a class="btn btn-sm btn-success" href="https://juliolanda.github.io/simulador-horno-solar-web/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open Simulator</a>
  <a class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" href="https://github.com/JulioLanda/simulador-horno-solar-web" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Web Repository</a>
  <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" href="https://github.com/JulioLanda/simulador-horno-solar" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Base Repository</a>
</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="col-md-6">
<div class="project-card">
<h3>Data Science and Methodology for Climate Analysis</h3>
<p>A 2026 academic workshop with reproducible materials for climate data analysis using automatic weather stations (EMA), EPW files and Jupyter notebooks. It integrates pandas, Plotly, Weather Data, Climate Consultant and EnerHabitat.</p>
<p class="badges">
  <span class="badge">Jupyter</span>
  <span class="badge">pandas</span>
  <span class="badge">Plotly</span>
  <span class="badge">Climate</span>
</p>
<img class="project-media" src="../images/taller-clima-ema-epw.png" alt="Comparison of climate data from an automatic weather station and an EPW file">
